criteria.criterion: Repository behavioral regression suite passes on the pinned candidate.
criteria.method: Ran `python3 -m unittest discover -s factory/tests -v` from a disposable clone checked out at the candidate SHA.

criteria.criterion: A synthetic work item can complete a normal PASS lifecycle through the documented CLI.
criteria.method: Executed create, Triage dispatch/report, justified Spec skip, Implement dispatch/report, independent Review dispatch/report, Verify dispatch/report, READY_FOR_HANDOFF, handoff, and COMPLETE using the CLI in the disposable clone.
criteria.evidence: CLI transcript `factory/work-items/FACTORY-BOOTSTRAP/evidence/verify-2-cli.log`; assertions confirmed final_result PASS.

criteria.criterion: A failed Verify revision requires fresh Implement and Review evidence before a succeeding Verify and handoff.
criteria.method: CLI lifecycle recorded FAIL Verify attempt 1, returned to BUILDING, confirmed REVIEWING was rejected before a fresh Implement report, confirmed VERIFYING was rejected before a fresh Review report, then completed attempt 2 and PASS handoff.
criteria.evidence: Same CLI transcript; assertions observed `fresh implementation report` and `current candidate review` gate errors, then final_result PASS.

criteria.criterion: BLOCKED and terminal FAIL handoffs preserve their result and terminal FAIL requires an explanatory reason.
criteria.method: Completed separate CLI fixtures for BLOCKED and FAIL. Tried terminal FAIL transition without a reason before retrying with a reason.
criteria.evidence: Same CLI transcript; missing reason was rejected with `terminal failure reason`; completed fixture final_result values were BLOCKED and FAIL.

criteria.criterion: Newer failed or closed runs invalidate older evidence so a previous PASS cannot authorize handoff.
criteria.method: Ran repository regression suite and a CLI fixture with an existing Implement report followed by a newer closed failed Implement run.
criteria.evidence: `test_latest_runs_invalidate_old_evidence` passed in the 13-test suite. CLI transcript confirms REVIEWING rejected the prior implementation evidence with `fresh implementation report` after the newer closed failed run.

criteria.criterion: Editing approved Spec content during the lifecycle requires reapproval and fresh implementation/review evidence, including before handoff.
criteria.method: Ran Spec-change regression tests and CLI fixtures editing Product content during Building and Tech content after verification at READY_FOR_HANDOFF.
criteria.evidence: `test_spec_change_requires_reapproval_and_fresh_attempt` and `test_spec_change_during_build_has_reapproval_route` passed. CLI transcript confirms changed content blocked REVIEWING/handoff; after reapproval, a fresh Implement and Review were required.

criteria.criterion: Interrupted handoff artifacts and their report/event mirrors can be reconstructed from durable state.
criteria.method: Ran interrupted-write recovery regression tests, then deleted a synthetic handoff's public note and journal in the CLI clone and invoked COMPLETE/recover.
criteria.evidence: `test_interrupted_handoff_artifacts_recover` and `test_interrupted_public_note_write_recovers` passed. CLI transcript confirms deleted journal/public note were recreated before completion; durable-state recovery remains available.
